metaTitle: Custom Cotton Poly Lanyards & Badges - Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly lanyards & badges for events, IDs, or promotions. Soft, durable, and perfect for bulk branding.
introHtml: Cotton poly lanyards combine the soft feel of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them ideal for all-day wear at conferences, schools, or corporate offices. Unlike all-polyester options, this blend resists fraying while remaining comfortable against the skin. Customize with full-color dye sublimation or screen printing to display your logo, event name, or safety messaging. Choose breakaway clasps for added security in high-traffic environments.
heroAltText: Custom cotton poly lanyards and badges with printed logos and safety breakaway clasps
